svg.title: Blue Black Red
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-last-paintings-05-2017/lightbox/works/blue-black-red-2015-42889; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
